name: std::enable_shared_from_this<T>::enable_shared_from_this
intro: Constructs a new enable_shared_from_this object. weak_this is value-initialized.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: There is no move constructor: moving from an object derived from enable_shared_from_this does not transfer its shared identity.
